content: {"like":["The acting for the most part was very good and very believable.","Nothing in this movie was predictable at all, especially the ironic ending.","Virginia Madsen and Patrick \"The Tick\" Warburton were both great as always.","The outside shots were beautifully shot.","The interior shots of the house were also very lovely and well shot.","There was some amusing dark humor.","Finally, it had a certain Talented Mr. Ripley type flair to it with one of the characters."],"dislike":["The events were out of place and completely absurd, with Christmas not playing into the movie.","Every once in a while the acting and the script would get a little bit corny and idiotic.","There was no gore.","There was no nudity.","The score is forgettable.","No one in this movie is likable in the least.","The pacing is slow and dull at times.","One of the characters having a middle digit stuck up at him at the end was too unbelievably corny, absolutely stupid and unnecessary, and it destroyed what was meant to be a serious situation."]}
